chunk_preview.text_preview: LION is a hydraulically driven, high-volume industrial fluid-transfer pump designed for continuous circulation and feeding duties. Its 4000 cc theoretical displacement and recommended delivery of 60 L/min at 15 cycles make it suitable for centralized coating and process-fluid handling systems.
